verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB says each agent run can get its own branch of production data on isolated compute, to experiment on and then throw away. It also offers isolated read-only agent compute and a free dev instance. This is true sandbox isolation, not a dry-run, but the evidence is homepage marketing only. Missing for 10: first-party docs on how branches are created and managed, explicit confirmation that branch writes never reach production tables, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Give each agent run its own branch of production data: isolated compute over the same S3. Let it experiment for real, then throw the branch away.
an agent runs on isolated, read-only compute over the same data, so it can't slow your production traffic.
Spin up a dev instance to kick the tires.
